description: Search the entries of an official Swiss code list on I14Y by code or text, e.g. NOGA industry classification ({codelist: 'NOGA_CLASS', query: 'bank'} or {codelist: 'NOGA_CLASS', query: '6419'}), NOGA levels NOGA_SECTION/NOGA_DIVISION/NOGA_GROUP/NOGA_CLASS/NOGA_TYPE, or any code list found with search_federal_metadata (pass its identifier or id).

codelist.description: Code list identifier (e.g. 'NOGA_CLASS') or concept id (UUID)

query.description: Code or words to search for

name: lookup_code_list
title: Look up an official code list (I14Y)
